Atrium Fixtures (schedule and results)

Source: R/atrium.R
atrium_fixtures.Rd

Fixtures (schedule and results) of a season, home and away side by side.

Endpoint: GET https://embed-api.eui.connect.sportradar.com/v1/embed/{website_id}/fixtures

Scores are integers (the API sends strings); start_time_utc is a UTC POSIXct; start_time_local is the venue's wall-clock time as the API sends it (character: its zone, timezone, varies per row, so no single POSIXct zone fits). sportsdataverse-py keeps both naive.

Usage

atrium_fixtures(
  website_id,
  season = NULL,
  season_id = NULL,
  competition_id = NULL,
  entity_id = NULL,
  round_number = NULL,
  sub = NULL,
  locale = NULL
)

Arguments

website_id

(integer required): Site config id: which league site's widget this is (12 LNB France, 14 LNBP Mexico, 3 NBL1 Australia, 13 El Salvador, 22 Panama, 236 Austria, 326 Montenegro). Not a league id: one site serves several competitions.

season

(integer optional): Season END year (2026 = 2025-26 on LNB, site 12, whose own year is the START year; the calendar year on the other sites). Needs competition_id when several competitions share that year (see atrium_seasons()). Omit season and season_id for the site's default season.

season_id

(character optional): Season UUID (season_id in atrium_seasons()); sent as is, skipping the END-year lookup of season.

competition_id

(character optional): Competition UUID (competition_id in atrium_seasons()). Picks the season together with season, and is then not sent; with neither season nor season_id the API filters by it.

entity_id

(character optional): Team UUID (entity_id in atrium_teams() or any fixture row).

round_number

(integer optional): Round (journee) number to show; the pages that take it list their rounds.

sub

(character optional): Tab: "FIXTURES" (upcoming) or "RESULTS" (played). Omitted = the site's default tab.

locale

(character optional): Locale of the labels, e.g. "en-EN" or "fr-FR". Omitted = the site's own language. Ids and codes never change.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble, one row per fixture_id:

Details

Unofficial. This is the public endpoint the Sportradar Atrium / Synergy "Connect" widget calls from every visitor's browser (keyless; the host has no robots.txt). The data is Sportradar's and the leagues'. The wrappers read it on the caller's behalf, one request at least 1 s after the last to the host. Keep crawls small and incremental.

Sites and seasons. website_id picks the league site; one site carries many competitions. Seasons are END years (season = 2026): the site's own year is the START year on LNB and the calendar year elsewhere, and a year can hold several competitions, so pair season with competition_id (see atrium_seasons()) or pass season_id. atrium_end_year() maps a site's own year to that END year, and atrium_season_id() finds the season UUID.

Columns are configured per site: a statistic one site omits is NA. A key the documented columns do not list is appended with an inferred type. Player and team ids (UUIDs, character) are shared across sites; the player stat tables carry names only, so person_id there is decoded from the widget link beside each name.

Errors (classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error): hoopR_no_data when the site has nothing for the request (HTTP 404, no such season, an empty fixture list, a game with no play-by-play yet, or a fixture id the site does not serve: an unknown id or a game of another site, which the API answers alike with an empty fixture); hoopR_bad_request for HTTP 400 / 422 or an argument that cannot be mapped (an ambiguous END year, season with season_id); hoopR_asset_fetch for any other failed fetch, an error / stub body, or a body that belongs to another site, type, season, game, player or team than the one asked for.
